fact: A 2022 case study says the health ministry put the DEMDZ electronic patient record into a set of pilot hospitals in 2018, that it is a web application reached over the intranet, and that after its installation at the CHU de Tizi-Ouzou in April 2019 the clinical team found it too deficient to use, so that only the laboratory and radiology systems were in use there and its exploitation was a failure.
title: Le système de santé en Algérie face au développement du numérique : le dossier du patient informatisé. Cas du CHU de Tizi-Ouzou
publisher: Revue Française d'Economie et de Gestion
